exposure: Fasting glucose levels in each trimester
Women whose newborns were normal weight
Fasting glucose levels divided into three categories
Women who had a normal delivery
Women who had a cesarean delivery
cohort: 829 healthy pregnant women receiving health care at a public maternity unit in Rio de Janeiro between 1999 and 2008
finding: Second and third trimester fasting glucose levels below the cut-off values for the diagnosis of GDM are associated with an increased risk of pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean delivery had higher fasting glucose levels in the second and third trimesters than women who had a normal delivery.
